title: Chicago Perfume Making Classes on Magnificent Mile
includes: Guided Experience: Expert guidance throughout the workshop on fragrance selection, blending techniques, and perfume creation.
Perfume Blending Tools: All necessary equipment provided, including pipettes, mixing beakers, and other blending tools.
Wide Selection of Fragrance Notes: Access to a variety of high-quality fragrance oils and essences, both synthetic and natural, to explore and choose from.
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step into the world of perfumery and unleash your creativity in a guided workshop! Explore a treasure trove of fragrance notes, from vibrant florals to exotic spices. With expert guidance, blend and harmonize these scents to craft a perfume that embodies your unique essence. Fill a luxurious 1.0oz bottle with your bespoke creation, personalized with a name or initials of your choice. Immerse yourself in this sensory journey, where every drop tells your story. Perfect for indulging solo or sharing with friends—an unforgettable experience awaits!
